question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}. On the trend table, accruals over total assets are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the lowest of the filled years. The earlier values are {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} in fiscal 2025, {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} in fiscal 2024, {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} in fiscal 2023 and {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} in fiscal 2022. Accruals are negative in every filled year, so reported earnings have sat below operating cash throughout the company's own history. This year the gap is extreme because the net loss of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} carries the non-cash loss on debt extinguishment. Cash over income has no stable meaning across loss and profit years: it was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2022 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2021. The cleaner test sets operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow} against operating income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income}, and cash is the larger. In each quarter of fiscal 2026 operating cash flow also exceeds net income: {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.3} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.3}, {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.2}, {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.1} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.1}, and {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.0} against {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0}. Working capital absorbed cash. The cash-flow statement shows receivables up {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change} and inventory up {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change}, partly funded by payables supplying {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}. The shares of net income ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income}) are negative only because the denominator is a loss dominated by a non-cash charge, so they tell us nothing. Inventory nearly articulates: the balance-sheet change is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} against the statement's {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. Payables do not. The balance sheet rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, but the statement credits operating cash with only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}. That gap keeps part of the payables build out of operating cash, which is the cautious direction. The numbers reader prints capital expenditures incurred but not yet paid rising sharply, the likely home of the gap. The calculator carries no field for that figure, so the link is inferred. Receivables cannot be articulated: the balance the release calls accounts receivable is tagged as a contract asset, so no balance-sheet change exists. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: income moves far more than cash, the opposite of smoothing. On the cash side, the annual incentive moved from equity to cash. That cut share-based compensation to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} and left accrued cash bonuses unpaid at year end, which helps this year's operating cash flow and will be paid from next year's. The extinguishment loss is non-cash but not costless: it measures conversion value in excess of principal handed to noteholders in shares, a real transfer from existing holders that never passes through operating cash flow.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Operating cash backs operating earnings. The GAAP loss is a non-cash financing charge, so the accrual extremes point to conservative, not inflated, earnings. Two items stay open: a payables articulation gap the filing does not explain, and a timing lift to operating cash from unpaid cash bonuses.

revenue_recognition.finding: Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} for the year. Fourth-quarter revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} rose {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter and {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on a year earlier. Days sales outstanding and receivables over revenue are not in the calculator, because the receivables line is tagged as a contract asset. No computed test of receivables outrunning revenue therefore exists. The cash-flow statement's receivables increase is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, which MD&A attributes to higher revenue. Fourth-quarter operating cash flow rose {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter, faster than revenue, which argues against a quarter-end push left uncollected. Receivables are concentrating faster than revenue. The largest receivable customer holds {concentration.facts.183.value|pct} of receivables against {concentration.facts.95.value|pct} a year earlier, rising through the year from {concentration.facts.128.value|pct} at the half-year and {concentration.facts.162.value|pct} at the third quarter. Customer A's revenue share is {concentration.facts.181.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.93.value|pct}. The filing does not say whether the receivable customer and Customer A are the same. Contract liabilities moved with revenue, not against it: {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}, a ratio to revenue of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}. Part of that rise is the Greensboro below-market contract liability, which amortizes into revenue without cash. The year brought new judgment areas. The Greensboro transitional supply agreement is recognized net, as agent. Tariff charges billed to customers are recorded as revenue, a gross presentation that lifts revenue and lowers margin percentages without moving profit; no prior-year text exists to date that wording. Revenue is tagged under both the including-tax and excluding-tax concepts with the same value, which only switches the trend table's concepts. The inputs hold no text on extended payment terms, bill-and-hold or changes to variable consideration.
revenue_recognition.verdict: There is no sign of revenue pulled forward: cash grew faster than revenue, and contract liabilities rose with it. Two items stay open: receivable days cannot be tested because of tagging, and receivables are concentrating in one customer faster than revenue.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance for credit losses is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance}, unchanged from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance}. Over the same year the statement shows receivables up {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, and the largest customer's share of receivables rose to {concentration.facts.183.value|pct}. The provision fell far below fiscal 2025's, and MD&A counts lower bad-debt expense among the SG&A drivers. Reserve cover thinned, and the calculator cannot compute the ratio. Warranty: the accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}. Its ratio to revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, in the middle of its history and below the fiscal 2024 high of {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}. The year's provisions include an acquisition-related Cloud Light provision. The release removes it from non-GAAP results, and the 10-K warranty table no longer footnotes it; without it the cover would be thinner. No inventory reserve is tagged in any period, and inventory valuation is the auditor's only critical audit matter. Goodwill: a reorganization changed the reporting units during the year, and goodwill was tested only qualitatively. The inputs disclose no headroom, discount rate or growth assumption, and the impairment heading in the goodwill note has no text under it. Tax: income tax is a benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}, mostly a fourth-quarter release of the US valuation allowance. The release came despite a stated cumulative US loss. It rests on a taxable-income estimate that excludes the extinguishment loss, and on backlog. The valuation allowance fell, but the release amount differs across the MD&A, the rate reconciliation and the allowance schedule, and the calculator holds none of these figures. This is the second year running in which a tax benefit carried the bottom line. Fiscal 2025 net income of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.net_income} came despite an operating loss of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_income}. Other estimate changes that raise income: the Thailand exemption concluded this year reaches back to fiscal 2025, and bad-debt expense was cut. Pulling the other way, unrecognized tax benefits rose and the China incentives expired.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Estimate-driven items lift earnings, chiefly the US valuation-allowance release. Credit-loss cover thinned while receivables grew. The release is a large judgment the filing explains, but no critical audit matter covers it.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding:
Deloitte's opinions on the statements and on internal control are unqualified. No material weakness is reported, and the controls item reports no fourth-quarter change. The inputs show no auditor change, though no prior-year report is available to compare. The only critical audit matter is inventory valuation. None covers the year's largest judgments: the US valuation-allowance release, the extinguishment loss and the Greensboro business combination. Despite the clean opinion, the filed 10-K carries many drafting and tagging defects:
- The subsequent-events note reads only 'TBD', while the tagged facts carry a post-year-end conversion.
- The goodwill-impairment heading has no text.
- A revenue table is introduced and does not follow.
- Paragraphs on pending standards name the wrong standard.
- Term-loan rates are transposed between MD&A and the debt note.
- Segment revenue members are swapped against the release.
- Segment tags contradict the single-segment text.
- The receivables line is tagged as a contract asset.
- The same current debt is tagged under two concepts, which the calculator adds twice: {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current}, against line values of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.0.value} and {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value}.
Prior-period values also changed quietly. Greensboro goodwill and assumed liabilities rose between the 10-Q and the 10-K with no reason given, while the allocation is still called preliminary. The Cloud Light contingent-consideration change flipped sign and gained an acquisition member. The 8-K item list shows officer-change filings in December 2025, January 2026 and July 2026, but their bodies are not in the input. Chief financial officer or chief accounting officer departures therefore cannot be ruled in or out. The chief financial officer modified a pre-arranged trading plan in the fourth quarter. The going-concern doubt language from the second-quarter 10-Q is gone. That fits cash and short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now} against current long-term debt of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.0.value}. The inputs show no late filing, amendment or SEC comment letter. The subsidiary-list diff was not provided.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: The audit opinion is clean, but disclosure quality is weak: many drafting and tagging errors, and quiet changes to prior-period values. The officer-change filings could not be read.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding:
The numbers confirm several notes items:
- the extinguishment loss
- the valuation-allowance direction
- the warranty build
- the receivables and inventory amounts MD&A explains
- receivable concentration
- the rise in purchase obligations
- the Greensboro revision
- the note repurchase amount
- the preferred issuance
- the fall in stock compensation
They contradict the single-segment statement, because the tagged facts carry operating-segment members. They also contradict the Components and Systems disaggregation, because the tagged members are swapped against the release and against the 10-K's own product shares. The other items are unresolved because the calculator carries no figure for them. The 8-K release matches the 10-K on the headline lines: revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}, operating income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income} and a net loss of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}. The calculator's derived fourth quarter, revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} and a net loss of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, equals the quarter the release prints. The release does not match on four points:
- segment members;
- the held-for-sale charge, an impairment in the release footnote at one amount, a different impairment in the fair-value note, and a loss on sale in MD&A;
- the escrow settlement's line;
- within the release itself, fiscal 2025 'Other charges (income), net', which differs between the adjusted EBITDA table and the GAAP to non-GAAP tables.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The headline figures reconcile. Segment disaggregation contradicts the text, and several charge descriptions disagree across documents.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: inventory rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} to {terms.balances_now.inventory}. MD&A says the builds support demand that exceeds supply, which lowers near-term obsolescence risk. But no reserve is tagged, days of inventory cannot be computed, and inventory valuation is the auditor's only critical audit matter, so this stays unresolved. Purchase commitments rose from the third quarter to year end, with softer cancellation rights, while inventory also rose. Supply allocation argues they are not in excess of need, but the exposure grew and became less cancellable. Customer concentration: Customer A's revenue share is {concentration.facts.181.value|pct}, against {concentration.facts.93.value|pct} in fiscal 2025 and {concentration.facts.11.value|pct} in fiscal 2024. It rose through the year, from {concentration.facts.124.value|pct} in the second quarter to {concentration.facts.158.value|pct} in the third. Customer B's share is {concentration.facts.182.value|pct}, and receivables are more concentrated still. Channel stuffing: nothing found. Sales go direct to large customers, demand exceeds supply, and fourth-quarter cash rose faster than revenue. No distributor or return-right text appears. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the inputs show no investment by the company in a customer. The reverse occurred: NVIDIA bought convertible preferred stock for cash. Customers A and B are unnamed and no related-party note is present, so whether the investor is also a major customer cannot be determined. A contract-manufacturer concentration fact is tagged as customer-concentration risk: {concentration.facts.185.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.97.value|pct}. MD&A cites rising receivables from contract manufacturers, but whether parts sold to them are recorded as revenue is not stated.
industry_lens.verdict: Concentration is the main industry risk, and it is rising. Inventory and commitment exposure grew while reserves stay untested. No circular deal is shown, but the preferred investor's customer status is unknown.

anomalies.name: Largest quarter of revenue backed by faster cash growth
anomalies.name_ko: 최대 분기 매출, 현금은 더 빠르게 증가
anomalies.what: Fourth-quarter revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} rose {ratios.growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} on the third quarter and {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} on a year earlier. Fourth-quarter operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} rose {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct}. The release's quarter agrees with the calculator's derived quarter. MD&A's account, demand exceeding supply, fits the pattern, and no quarter-end push is visible.

anomalies.name: Credit-loss allowance flat while receivables grew
anomalies.what: The allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} at year end, the same as {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year earlier. The provision fell far below fiscal 2025's, and MD&A cites lower bad-debt expense. Meanwhile the statement shows receivables up {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, and the largest customer holds {concentration.facts.183.value|pct} of receivables. Reserve cover thinned, and the lower expense lifted earnings.

anomalies.name: US valuation-allowance release despite a cumulative US loss
anomalies.what: Income tax is a benefit of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}, mostly the fourth-quarter release. Management acknowledges a cumulative US loss and supports the release with backlog and with an income estimate that excludes the extinguishment loss. At the third quarter, the same assets were judged not realizable. The release also let a capped-call deferred tax asset be credited to equity. No critical audit matter covers it.

anomalies.name: Valuation-allowance release amounts differ across disclosures
anomalies.what: The MD&A release, the rate reconciliation's valuation-allowance line and the allowance schedule's deductions line each print a different amount. The remaining allowance the prose names is also smaller than the tagged year-end balance. Foreign allowances, items credited to equity or current-year additions could reconcile them. The filing does not reconcile them, and the calculator holds none of these figures.

anomalies.name: Tax benefits carry the bottom line in consecutive years
anomalies.what: Fiscal 2025 net income of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.net_income} came despite an operating loss of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_income}, helped by a tax benefit. The notes reader also lists an MD&A paragraph on a prior-year UK allowance release that it did not itemize. Fiscal 2026 brings a larger benefit from the US release. An item presented as a one-off judgment has lifted the bottom line in back-to-back years.

anomalies.name: Warranty cover slightly lower, with an acquired-product provision inside
anomalies.what: Warranty accrual over revenue is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio}, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} a year earlier and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio} in fiscal 2024. The accrual rose to {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}, but the year's provisions include an acquisition-related Cloud Light provision. The 10-Q footnoted that provision; the 10-K table no longer does. Without it, cover would be lower.

anomalies.name: Goodwill reporting units changed; qualitative test only
anomalies.what: A reorganization during the year changed the reporting units. Goodwill was assessed only qualitatively, both at an interim date and at the annual test. No headroom, discount rate or growth assumption is disclosed, and the impairment heading has no text under it.

anomalies.name: Thailand tax exemption concluded retroactively
anomalies.name_ko: 태국 투자청 면세 요건 소급 판단
anomalies.what: This year management concluded that exemption requirements were met for projects covering fiscal 2025 as well as fiscal 2026. That is an income-raising judgment reaching back to a prior year, and no tagged amount isolates its effect.

anomalies.name: Unrecognized tax benefits rising
anomalies.what: Unrecognized tax benefits, and the interest and penalties accrued on them, rose between year ends. That is the more cautious reserve direction, and it partly offsets the income-raising tax judgments. The China incentives have expired.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP exclusions expanded; gap not computable
anomalies.what: The release turns a GAAP net loss into non-GAAP net income. Its exclusions now cover an acquisition-related warranty provision, the escrow settlement, the extinguishment loss and inducement expense. They also remove legal fees for matters the 10-K does not identify. Non-GAAP diluted shares are reduced for a capped call that GAAP treats as anti-dilutive. No non-GAAP figure is tagged, so the gap cannot be computed against history.

anomalies.name: 'Other charges' and restructuring recur
anomalies.what: The release's 'Other charges (income), net' carries an amount in every period column. Restructuring for reductions in force appears this year, and the notes carry prior-year restructuring. Items excluded as non-recurring keep recurring.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at the low of its comparable years
anomalies.what: Soft assets over total assets are {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.soft_asset_share}. The fall comes from cash raised by the preferred issuance and from plant growth, not from write-downs. The one judgment-driven soft asset that rose is the deferred tax asset recognized on the allowance release.

anomalies.name: Capital spending incurred but unpaid rose sharply
anomalies.what: Capital expenditures incurred but not yet paid rose sharply. Cash capital spending of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} therefore understates the year's investment, and free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} is flattered until those payables are paid. The payables articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap} is the calculator field closest to that build-up.

anomalies.name: Tax withheld on equity awards paid through financing
anomalies.what: Tax withheld on net-share settlement rose sharply and is paid through financing, outside free cash flow. It is a cash cost of equity pay on top of the {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} of share-based compensation already subtracted. The calculator carries no field for it, so no adjustment is possible.

anomalies.name: Convertible proceeds left out of the tagged debt-issuance total
anomalies.what: The company tags {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued} as total proceeds from debt issuance, yet a separate convertible-proceeds line of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.lines_not_added.0.value} is larger. The calculator treats the first as the total, so its net borrowing of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity.net_borrowing} omits the convertible proceeds.

anomalies.name: Conversion settlement wording widened to cash
anomalies.what: Principal on post-year-end conversions is settled in cash. The third-quarter text said the excess conversion value would be settled in shares; it may now be settled in cash, shares or both, at the company's election. Conversion cash outflows can therefore exceed principal, measured against cash and short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now}.

anomalies.name: Subsequent-events note filed as 'TBD'
anomalies.what: The filed note consists of a heading and 'TBD'. Yet the 10-K's tagged facts carry a conversion dated after year end, and the debt note and MD&A describe post-year-end conversion requests.

anomalies.name: Drafting errors across the filed notes
anomalies.what: The goodwill-impairment heading has no text. A revenue-by-product table is introduced and does not follow. Paragraphs on pending standards name a different standard in the adoption sentence than in the heading. Term-loan rates are transposed between MD&A and the debt note. Each error is small, but together they point to weak review of the filed document, despite the conclusion that controls are effective.

anomalies.name: Single-segment text against operating-segment tags
anomalies.name_ko: 단일 부문 서술과 부문 태그의 모순
anomalies.what: The notes state a single reporting segment. But the 10-K tags fiscal 2026 revenue under Components and Systems members on the operating-segments axis. The third-quarter 10-Q tagged a single segment for the year to date while tagging more than one for fiscal 2025.

anomalies.name: Accounts receivable tagged as contract assets
anomalies.what: The line the release calls 'Accounts receivable, net' is tagged as a contract asset at both year ends. A contract asset is a conditional right to payment, while a receivable is an unconditional one. Either the tag is wrong, or unbilled revenue is larger than the label implies. The tag also disables every receivables test in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Tagging choices block margin and inventory tests
anomalies.what: Cost of sales is tagged under a concept that excludes depreciation and amortization, outside the concepts the calculator reads. Gross margin, days of inventory and days payable therefore have no filled period. Revenue is tagged under both the including-tax and excluding-tax concepts with the same value. The contract-liability and plant concepts switched across years, which shortens the comparable histories.

anomalies.name: Same current debt tagged under two concepts
anomalies.what: At both year ends, the same amount is tagged as current long-term debt and as short-term borrowings: {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.0.value} and {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value}. The calculator adds both, so its current debt of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current}, and its total and net debt, include the duplicate.

anomalies.name: Greensboro purchase allocation revised without explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 그린즈버러 인수가격 배분의 설명 없는 수정
anomalies.what: For the same date, the 10-K prints higher Greensboro goodwill and assumed noncurrent liabilities than the 10-Q did. The below-market contract liability the notes describe moved with them. The allocation is still called preliminary, and no reason is given.

anomalies.name: Cloud Light contingent-consideration change flipped sign
anomalies.what: The 10-Q tagged the change as a negative amount with no acquisition member. The 10-K tags the same period as positive, with the Cloud Light member. The amount equals the escrow settlement gain, which the documents present three different ways: as other income, as a separate line and as a litigation-settlement gain.

anomalies.name: Single critical audit matter, none on the year's largest judgments
anomalies.what: Deloitte's only critical audit matter is inventory valuation. The US valuation-allowance release, the extinguishment accounting and the Greensboro business combination carry none. No prior-year report is in the inputs to show whether any matters were dropped.

anomalies.name: CFO modified a pre-arranged trading plan
anomalies.what: In the fourth quarter, the chief financial officer and the president of global business units modified pre-arranged trading plans first adopted in November 2025. The chief executive adopted a new one. The 8-K item list also shows officer-change filings for December 2025, January 2026 and July 2026, but without bodies, so departures can be neither confirmed nor ruled out.

anomalies.name: Going-concern doubt language gone
anomalies.what: The second-quarter 10-Q said note conversions raised substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern. That language is gone, and MD&A now states that liquidity is sufficient. Cash and short-term investments of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now} exceed current long-term debt of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.0.value}, and the current ratio is {ratios.liquidity.current_ratio}.

anomalies.name: Components and Systems revenue swapped between documents
anomalies.what: The 10-K tags the larger fiscal 2026 amount to the Systems member, while the release prints it for Components. The 10-K's own product shares give Components {concentration.facts.186.value|pct} and Systems {concentration.facts.187.value|pct}. The fiscal 2025 members agree across documents.

anomalies.name: 'Other charges' differ inside the release
anomalies.name_ko: 보도자료 내 기타 비용 금액 불일치
anomalies.what: For fiscal 2025, 'Other charges (income), net' prints one amount in the adjusted EBITDA reconciliation and a different one in both GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliations. The other columns agree.

anomalies.name: Held-for-sale charge described differently across documents
anomalies.what: The fair-value note states impairment charges on assets held for sale at one amount. The release footnote calls a different amount an impairment to write down assets held for sale. The property note and MD&A call that same amount a loss on the sale of the San Jose buildings, recorded in SG&A. No tagged figure decides between them.

anomalies.name: Escrow settlement presented differently
anomalies.what:
The amounts agree, but the presentation does not:
- The notes and MD&A record the gain in other income.
- The release shows it on a separate line.
- The other-income table lists no escrow component.
- MD&A credits it with part of the growth in interest and investment income.
- The tag is a litigation-settlement gain.

anomalies.name: Inventory build with no tagged reserve
anomalies.what: Inventory rose by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} to {terms.balances_now.inventory}. No reserve is tagged in any period and no write-down is tagged for the year. Days of inventory cannot be computed, and inventory valuation is the auditor's only critical audit matter. Demand above supply lowers near-term obsolescence risk, while fast product transitions raise it.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments rising with softer cancellation rights
anomalies.what: Remaining purchase commitments rose from the third quarter to year end. The cancellation wording moved from 'generally allow' to 'may allow'. The note says obligations are fulfilled within a year, but the MD&A table shows amounts due later. With inventory also up, the exposure grew and became less cancellable. Supply allocation argues it is not yet in excess of need.

anomalies.name: Customer concentration rising
anomalies.what: Customer A's share of revenue is {concentration.facts.181.value|pct}, against {concentration.facts.93.value|pct} in fiscal 2025 and {concentration.facts.11.value|pct} in fiscal 2024. The share rose through the year: {concentration.facts.124.value|pct} in the second quarter and {concentration.facts.158.value|pct} in the third. Customer B's share is {concentration.facts.182.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.94.value|pct}. MD&A warns of margin pressure from high customer concentration.

anomalies.name: Preferred-stock investor's customer status undisclosed
anomalies.what: NVIDIA bought convertible preferred stock for cash in March 2026, and equity rose to {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity}. Customers A and B are unnamed, and no related-party note is present. Whether the investor is also a major customer cannot be determined, nor whether the investment came with supply or pricing terms. The inputs show no investment by the company in a customer.

anomalies.name: Contract-manufacturer flows not described
anomalies.what: A contract-manufacturer concentration fact is tagged as customer-concentration risk: {concentration.facts.185.value|pct}, against {concentration.facts.97.value|pct} a year earlier. MD&A cites rising receivables from contract manufacturers, driven by volume. The filing does not say whether parts sold to contract manufacturers are recorded as revenue or treated as a pass-through.

adjustments.name: Capital spending incurred but unpaid at year end
adjustments.quote: Capital expenditures incurred but not yet paid (tagged with the PropertyPlantAndEquipmentMember) are 181400000 for fiscal 2026, against 43400000 for fiscal 2025.

adjustments.name: US valuation-allowance release inside the income tax benefit
adjustments.quote: we developed an objectively verifiable estimate of future taxable income based upon our recent U.S. operating results which excluded the loss on debt extinguishment

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 영업현금흐름 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}이 영업이익 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income}보다 커서 영업이익은 현금으로 뒷받침됩니다. 순손실 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}은 현금이 나가지 않는 사채 소멸손실 때문이며, 발생액 비율 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}이 과거 최저인 것도 그 때문입니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출은 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} 늘었고 마지막 분기 영업현금흐름이 매출보다 빠르게 늘어, 매출을 앞당긴 징후는 보이지 않습니다. 다만 매출채권이 계약자산으로 태그되어 회전일수를 계산할 수 없고, 최대 고객의 매출채권 비중 {concentration.facts.183.value|pct}가 매출 비중 {concentration.facts.181.value|pct}보다 빠르게 올랐습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 법인세 혜택 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}은 대부분 미국 평가충당금 환입이라는 판단에서 나온 일회성 이익입니다. 대손충당금은 매출채권이 크게 늘었는데도 {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance}에 머물러 있습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 없고, 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용으로 처리되었습니다. 다만 비GAAP 조정 항목이 늘었고 '기타 비용'과 전환사채 관련 비용이 반복됩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 팩토링이나 공급망 금융은 확인되지 않았습니다. 다만 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}은 아직 지급하지 않은 설비투자 덕분에 부풀려져 있고, 주식보상 원천징수 세금 지출은 재무활동으로 분류되어 빠져 있습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사의견은 적정이고 중요한 취약점도 없습니다. 하지만 후속사건 주석이 'TBD'로 제출되는 등 작성·태깅 오류가 많고, 이전 분기 수치가 설명 없이 바뀌었습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K의 매출 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.revenue}과 순손실 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}은 10-K와 일치합니다. 그러나 부품·시스템 매출 태그가 서로 뒤바뀌어 있고, 단일 부문이라는 서술과도 모순됩니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 최대 고객 A의 매출 비중이 {concentration.facts.181.value|pct}로 전년 {concentration.facts.93.value|pct}보다 크게 올랐습니다. 재고 {terms.balances_now.inventory}와 구매약정이 함께 늘었지만 재고충당금은 공시되지 않았으며, 우선주를 산 NVIDIA가 주요 고객인지도 알 수 없습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
